description: Ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text in a way that does not rely on color
help: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
failureSummary: Fix any of the following:\n  The link has insufficient color contrast of 2.76:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #ca1236, surrounding text: #222222)\n  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
